args.title: Announce error toasts assertively and keep them until dismissed
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Error toasts currently share the same `aria-live="polite"` region as info/success toasts and are auto-dismissed after AUTO_DISMISS_MS like every other kind. Render error toasts in an `aria-live="assertive"` (role="alert") region, or switch the region's politeness based on whether any visible toast is an error, and skip the auto-dismiss timer for `kind === "error"` so they stay until the user dismisses them.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Toast.tsx renders a single `role="status" aria-live="polite"` region for all toast kinds, and the `Toast` component always sets a 5s auto-dismiss timer regardless of `kind`. Error toasts need an assertive/alert live region and no auto-dismiss so they stay until the user closes them.
